payout_value_note: Flat $100 to referrer and $100 to the new member. Promotion limited to the first 100 qualifying referrals overall (program-wide, not per-referrer).
payout_quote: When the referred new member meets all eligibility and qualification requirements outlined below, both the referring member and the new member will receive a $100 reward. ... The promotion begins March 1, 2026 and is limited to the first 100 qualifying referrals.
steps: Referring member must have an active Valley Credit Union account in good standing.
Submit the referral through the official online referral form BEFORE the new member opens a checking account; share the unique referral link.
New member applies for membership using the referral link; must not have had a Valley checking account in the previous 12 months.

New member: opens a Valley checking account; keeps it open and in good standing for at least 90 consecutive days; completes at least 15 posted point-of-sale debit card transactions within 90 days (ATM transactions do not qualify); establishes and maintains recurring direct deposit of payroll/pension/government benefits within 90 days (P2P transfers like Venmo/Cash App/PayPal do not qualify).
Rewards paid after verification of the 90-day qualification period; reward may be taken as account deposit or donated to an eligible nonprofit.
catches: Promotion limited to the first 100 qualifying referrals overall — once 100 are reached the promotion ends.
New member must keep the account open 90 days AND complete 15 POS debit transactions AND set up qualifying direct deposit within 90 days.
Peer-to-peer transfers (Venmo, Cash App, PayPal) do not count as direct deposit.
ATM transactions do not count toward the 15 debit transactions.
Employees, Board members, and Supervisory Committee members are not eligible.
Rewards may be reported to the IRS; members responsible for tax liability.
Valley CU may modify, suspend, or terminate the promotion at any time without notice.
biggest_catch: The promotion ends after the first 100 qualifying referrals, and the new member must keep the account open 90 days while completing 15 debit transactions and direct deposit before the $100 is paid.
eligibility: Valley CU members in good standing; new member must meet standard membership eligibility and not have had a Valley checking account in the last 12 months.
timing: Form submission ~10 min active; rewards paid after verification of the 90-day qualification period.
